title: An order summary
description:
Read order lines until a line that is just `end` (or until the input runs out). Each line is `name,quantity,price`, for example `Tea,3,2.50`. Print a table with the columns lined up, then the total:

```
Tea,3,2.50
Sandwich,1,6.25
Cake slice,2,3
end
Item            Qty    Price    Total
Tea               3     2.50     7.50
Sandwich          1     6.25     6.25
Cake slice        2     3.00     6.00
Total                           19.75
```

- The header and rows use `string.format("%-12s %6s %8s %8s", ...)` for the header and `"%-12s %6d %8.2f %8.2f"` for each row; the total line is `"%-12s %24.2f"` with the word `Total`.
- Spaces around the commas are allowed and ignored (`Tea , 3 , 2.50`).
- A line that does not have that form prints `Skipped: <the line>` at the point it is read, before the table, and is left out.
- With no valid lines at all, print only `No orders.` (after any `Skipped:` lines).

There is no prompt.

starter.main.lua:
for line in io.lines() do
    if line == "end" then break end
    print(line)
end

solution.main.lua:
local orders = {}
for line in io.lines() do
    if line == "end" then break end
    local name, qty, price = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+%.?%d*)%s*$")
    if name and name ~= "" then
        orders[#orders + 1] = { name = name, qty = tonumber(qty), price = tonumber(price) }
    else
        print("Skipped: " .. line)
    end
end

if #orders == 0 then
    print("No orders.")
else
    print(string.format("%-12s %6s %8s %8s", "Item", "Qty", "Price", "Total"))
    local total = 0
    for _, o in ipairs(orders) do
        local line_total = o.qty * o.price
        total = total + line_total
        print(string.format("%-12s %6d %8.2f %8.2f", o.name, o.qty, o.price, line_total))
    end
    print(string.format("%-12s %24.2f", "Total", total))
end

hints: One pattern does it: `^%s*(.-)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+%.?%d*)%s*$`. Captures are strings, so convert quantity and price with `tonumber`.
`%-12s` pads to 12 characters on the right; `%8.2f` is 8 wide with 2 decimals.

examples.expected:

Tea               3     2.50     7.50
Sandwich          1     6.25     6.25
Cake slice        2     3.00     6.00
Total                           19.75

examples.name: spaces and a bad line
examples.stdin:
Tea , 3 , 2.50
just text
Bread,two,1.20
Jam, 1, 4.5
end
examples.expected:
Skipped: just text
Skipped: Bread,two,1.20
Item            Qty    Price    Total
Tea               3     2.50     7.50
Jam               1     4.50     4.50
Total                           12.00
